Key Initiatives

  • Apertus - Fully open, transparent multilingual language model by ETH Zurich

  • Public AI Inference Utility - Global access to Swiss AI models

Strengths

Methodology

Country rankings are based on comprehensive evaluation using the SAIL Specification. Points are awarded across seven layers based on demonstrated capacity, legal robustness, and exit readiness. Certification levels are determined by total points earned (out of 175 possible).
